description: Supports Deezer 9.0.27.4, removes added audio quality choices, and keeps the optional .morphe package suffix enabled by default.

patches.name: Block ads
patches.description: Hides banner and native ads and skips visual pre-rolls and audio ad breaks.

patches.name: Choose tracks on demand
patches.description: Select tracks in search, albums, playlists, artist pages, profiles, and Deezer recommendations. Restore the last queue and keep the current track playing when starting its mix.

patches.name: Enable offline downloads
patches.description: Unlocks the OFFLINE entitlement and download actions in menus (subject to server-side stream availability).

patches.name: Enable player navigation
patches.description: Enables unlimited track skips, previous and next controls, and seeking within a track.

patches.name: Hide Premium offers
patches.description: Hides offer pop-ups, the Premium tab, upgrade buttons, and audio quality upgrade prompts.

patches.name: Install alongside official Deezer
patches.description: Adds .morphe to the package ID. Deselect to keep deezer.android.app. Replacing an existing official installation requires uninstalling it because the signing keys differ.

patches.name: Manage the playback queue
patches.description: Opens the queue and adds Add to queue and Play Next to supported menus.

patches.name: Open lyrics from the player
patches.description: Opens Deezer's lyrics view instead of the Premium prompt when a lyrics button is tapped.

patches.name: Search and sort playlists
patches.description: Adds the native search shortcut to playlist headers and Sort to playlist menus.

release_notes:
Supports Deezer 9.0.27.4.

- Removes **Show audio quality choices**. Available qualities follow native account permissions; quality upgrade prompts remain hidden by **Hide Premium offers**.
- Keeps **Install alongside official Deezer** enabled by default. Deselect it to retain the original package ID.
- Adapts patch references and resources to the new app build and removes the obsolete startup restoration required by 9.0.27.3.

Validated all nine patches together on an Android 14 emulator with host GPU acceleration, and the eight remaining patches with the suffix disabled. Both APKs passed signature verification and the DEX reference audit. Actual notification taps reopened the correct installation in both modes. Playback, seeking, mixes, queue actions, lyrics, playlist search/sort, album download and offline playback were checked.

Only Standard was shown for the tested Free account. All 14 downloaded Discovery tracks remained MP3_128. Physical Android Auto and every account/region scenario are not covered by these checks. Use earlier bundle releases for earlier supported app versions.
